# The Elisabeth Gauba School

> The Elisabeth Gauba School (formerly and locally known as Shiv Niketan School) is a pre-primary and primary school in central New Delhi, India, founded in 1938 by Mrs. Elisabeth Gauba. It offers Nursery, Kindergarten (K.G.), and Class I through Class V, with small-group, child-centred teaching near President's Estate and Gole Market.

Key facts:
- Founded: 1938, by Mrs. Elisabeth Gauba, originally at 8 Hailey Road, New Delhi
- Run by: The Shiv Niketan Society (registered 1969)
- Classes offered: Nursery, K.G., Class I-V
- School hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-1:40 PM
- Academic session: April-March, with summer break (mid-May-early July), Dussehra break (October), and winter break (December-January)
- Address: Sector-II, DIZ Area, Kali Bari Marg (Entry from Gate No-9, Kali Bari Lane), New Delhi 110001
- Phone: +91-8800541280 / 011-23367633 / 011-41646990
- Email: shivniketan1@rediffmail.com
- Notable former Chairperson: Habib Tanvir (Padma Bhushan recipient, theatre personality), Chairperson from 1984
- Current Chairperson: Dr. Ranjana Kaul, senior advocate
- Notable alumni: Rajiv Gandhi (former Prime Minister of India), Sanjay Gandhi, Kabir Bedi (actor)
